scope: r27 HDR/SDR transition quiesce-present candidate. Live testing proved the artifact occurs only with FG and disappears when FG is manually disabled before HDR/SDR switching. r27 mirrors that safe ordering by committing eOff through one real Streamline Present before ResizeBuffers, then retains r26 two-fresh-frame warmup.

assertions: When FG is already off, HDR/SDR ResizeBuffers proceeds without a synthetic Present.
When FG is active, r27 queues DLSSGMode::eOff and performs one real inner swap-chain Present before HDR bridge mutation or ResizeBuffers.
The quiesce Present uses Flags=0; DXGI_PRESENT_TEST is explicitly not used because Streamline skips normal Present processing for test presents.
The r26 two-consecutive-fresh-domain-frame warmup remains after the resize; FG may re-enable only on the following app Present.
The r25 common-constants transition reset remains absent.
RR and the r24 compute-only RGB10/PQ HUDless conversion are unchanged.
